"""Maximum wire-output replay: enabled 9-node flow, 2 MiB of packets."""
import json, time, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import run

H = 256
kinds = 'K' * 251 + 'D' * 2 + 'QZT'   # Q at 253, Z at 254, T at 255
tpl = bytes(range(256))
nodes = ['n%d' % i for i in range(9)]
flow = {'id': 'big', 'path': nodes, 'template': tpl.hex(), 'kinds': kinds,
        'labels': [1048575 - i for i in range(9)]}
hdr = bytearray(tpl)
hdr[253] = 7       # Q
hdr[254] = 0       # Z (ignored)
hdr[255] = 255     # TTL
payload = 'ab' * 2048
events = [{'op': 'put', 'flow': 'big', 'node': n} for n in nodes]
events.append({'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'big'})
n_packets = (2 * 1024 * 1024) // (H + 2048)
for _ in range(n_packets):
    events.append({'op': 'packet', 'flow': 'big', 'header': bytes(hdr).hex(), 'payload': payload})
req = {'mode': 'replay', 'capacities': {n: 1 for n in nodes}, 'flows': [flow], 'events': events}
print('packets', n_packets, 'packet bytes', n_packets * (H + 2048))
t = time.time()
out = run([req], timeout=120)
dt = time.time() - t
resp = json.dumps(out[0])
r0 = out[0]['results'][-1]
print('time %.2fs response %.1f MiB' % (dt, len(resp) / 1048576))
print('links', len(r0['wire']), 'link bytes', len(r0['wire'][0]) // 2, 'byte_hops', r0['byte_hops'])
print('delivered len', len(r0['delivered']) // 2, 'ok' if r0['delivered'] == bytes(hdr[:253]).hex() + '00' + '07' + '%02x' % (255 - 8) + payload else 'BAD')
EOF
